prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-51037
prose.body:
Hi Fallowfield Games team,

We hope you're enjoying the leftovers from our recent collaboration! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-51037 for $1249.86 USDC.

To settle the balance, please send the payment to our standard vendor wallet: 0x7dfea9a3b601d239f58508d6a6a5991eded760a4. This is the same address we've used for previous transactions, so it should look familiar in your records.

Once the transfer is complete, kindly share the transaction hash with our accounts team at billing@fennick-catering.example so we can mark the invoice as paid and update our books. If you have any questions about the amount or need a copy of the original invoice, just reply to this email and we'll get back to you promptly.

Thanks for being a great partner! We look forward to serving you again soon.

Best regards,
The Fennick Catering Team
